overall: The AG found a violation only for the outside-consultants topic (#5), whose notice text was too vague. The fee-waiver discussion, the votes on items with 'discussion' notices, and the public-comment allegation were not violations or were declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged agenda item #4 (a site plan hearing) lacked specificity because the board later discussed a filing fee waiver not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the listed agenda topic #4 was sufficient to reasonably advise the public of the issues to be discussed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged agenda item #5 (outside consultants under G.L. c. 44, §53G) was listed with insufficient specificity, and the board then discussed and voted on it.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, topic #5 on the meeting notice lacks sufficient specificity as required by law, and we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board held votes on items #3 and #5 although the notice said only 'discussion' and did not state that action could be taken.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it held votes on topics #3 and #5 without specifying on the meeting notice that votes may be taken.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged public comment was allowed inconsistently with the notice: none for a 'Public Hearing' item, but allowed on 'Discussion' items.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation, even if true, would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law, we decline to review it.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
